rules: 15m bars, 2/2 fractal swings; only swings formed in the current trading day (18:00 NY roll) count
decision 09:30 NY = close of the full 09:15 15m bar

bull case: a 15m bar starting in [08:30, 09:30) traded above an intact same-day swing high confirmed before it, and >= 2 intact same-day 15m swing lows (never traded below) exist at 09:30; bear case mirrored
hit: any of the first 30 M1 bars from 09:30 trades to the nearest stacked swing (low <= level / high >= level)
null: 5 moments +/-30d at the same NY minute (09:30), same side, distance from the M1 open scaled by local vol ratio (mean M1 range, 60 bars before), same 30-bar horizon
